subject: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@novalabs.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount

Hi Sophie — great to connect today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Usage profile you mentioned: inference for product recommendations (approx initial pilot: 10M generation tokens / month, plus ~2M embedding tokens).
- Primary goals: keep latency <150ms p50, predictable per-token unit cost for scale, and a 12–24 month pricing commitment if unit economics look right.

To help us put together a formal quote, can you confirm:
1) Expected steady-state monthly token volume (gen + embeddings) after Q1 post-launch (best guess is fine).
2) Target blended $/1M tokens you’d need to hit in order to justify a committed purchase (you mentioned ~$150–$200 as a target range on the call).
3) Your budget envelope for the first 12 months (range is fine).

From our side — packaging options we typically propose: 
- Startup program: additional credits (we typically provide a 10% credit applied to first 3 months) for qualifying seed-stage startups (we'll need a simple certificate).
- Committed-use (12 months): tiered discounts off list depending on commit size (we can run numbers, but typical starting point is ~25–35% off list for modest commits).
- Multi-year / prepay: ~35–45% off list for larger upfront commitments (and we can include price protection).

I attached our current pricing workbook (Redwood_Pricing_20261115.xlsx) with a blank committed-use template. If you can share the startup cert and a rough monthly volume, I’ll build 2-3 concrete quotes (12-month, 18-month prepay) that show the blended $/1M tokens and monthly invoice estimate.

Next steps: if you can send the startup cert and a ballpark monthly volume, I’ll get a formal quote over by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Ben

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_20261115.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@novalabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount

Hi Ben — thanks for the follow-up and the sheet. Quick answers below:

1) Steady-state estimate: ~12M gen tokens/month + ~3M embedding tokens/month by end of Q1 (we expect growth after onboarding).
2) Target blended $/1M tokens: ideally $150–$200 to make the economics work for our ARR targets.
3) Budget envelope (first 12 months): $50k–$100k (we’re bootstrapped/seed but planning to raise in H1).

We are a seed-stage startup — happy to share our incorporation docs and a short startup certificate (attached). Can you confirm whether the startup program credit stacks with a committed-use discount? Also interested in multi-year pricing if it makes sense (we’d need price protection and a cap on per-token increases).

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Nguyen
Head of Product | NovaLabs
sophie@novalabs.ai | (650) 555-9931

Attachment: startup_cert_novalabs.pdf (simple startup cert)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@novalabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount

Hi Sophie — appreciate the details and the cert. Yes — the startup credit can stack with a committed-use discount for qualifying customers (credit applied to invoices first, then committed discount on remaining bill).

Attached is an initial committed-use quote (redwood_committed_quote_12345.pdf) with two priced options based on the volumes you shared (12M gen + 3M embed):

Option A — 12-month committed use (monthly billing, 1-month ramp credit):
- Commit: equivalent of 10M gen tokens/month baseline (blended with embeddings)
- Discount: 30% off list unit rate
- Startup credit: 10% applied to first 3 months
- Resulting blended estimate: ~$180 / 1M tokens (approx — see quote)
- Estimated monthly invoice (month 4 onward): ~$2.0k–$2.5k depending on exact mix

Option B — 18-month prepay (upfront):
- Larger commit, 35% off list + 10% startup credit applied as account credit
- Resulting blended estimate: ~$150 / 1M tokens
- Price protection included for the contract term

Notes: the blended $/1M above is illustrative — final depends on token mix (generation vs embeddings) and peak usage. We can model two growth scenarios in the quote.

I also attached a short draft of multiyear terms (Draft_Terms_MultiYear.pdf) that shows how price protection and termination for convenience would work.

If either option looks reasonable I’ll put together a DocuSign-ready quote and loop in RevOps for billing setup.

Best — Ben

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_committed_quote_12345.pdf (PDF), Draft_Terms_MultiYear.pdf (PDF)

From: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@novalabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount

Thanks Ben — Option B looks interesting (the ~$150 / 1M tokens blended is in-line with what we need). A couple quick clarifying Qs before we move to a signature:

- Can the multi-year prepay include a 12-month price protection clause (no increases >5% per year)?
- Any SLA credits for availability/latency breaches (we rely on this for production)?

If you can send a DocuSign quote with the Option B numbers + the protection language, I’ll review and route for approval internally.

— Sophie

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@novalabs.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount

Hi Sophie — looping in from Sales Ops. We reviewed Ben's proposal and can approve Option B as outlined with the following confirmed items:

- 18-month prepay at 35% off list, plus the standard startup credit (10% applied over first 3 months).
- Price protection: we will include a clause capping increases at 5% year-over-year during the contracted term.
- SLA: standard SLA for Dedicated customers applies; for hosted we include availability credits up to 10% of monthly fees for qualifying incidents. If you need a stricter SLA we can discuss an elevated SLA add-on.

Next steps: Ben will send a DocuSign quote. Aditya — please prepare billing profile and confirm tax & banking details once Sophie signs.

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Internal note: Approved per revops playbook; startup proof attached is sufficient.

Attachment: redwood_committed_quote_12345.pdf (finalized PDF)
